name: duplicate_and_reorder_hold
regression: Duplicated and out-of-order delivery of the safety state: the arbiter drops older (epoch, seq) states (P8), the hold holds, and the flight analyzer reports the transport faults.
initial_conditions: As nominal_motion, but at t=3.0 s an injected benign HELIX fault is diagnosed, STOP_AND_HOLD is accepted and /helix/hold asserts (epoch/seq ordered, 10 Hz); /nav/cmd_vel keeps commanding 0.15 m/s throughout.
injected_fault: Hold messages are delivered twice between t=1 and 2 s, and in swapped pairs between t=4 and 5 s while held.
